title: Establish the Minitest and system-test foundation
summary: Created reusable deterministic Minitest support for clocks, UUIDs, encrypted-value checks, exact-body signatures, scoped Current tenancy, tenant isolation, jobs, idempotency, permission/audit/usage decisions and strict provider fakes; added a loopback-only malicious HTTP fixture, organized test layers, hardened headless Chrome failure artifacts and documented suite tiers and seed reproduction.

tests.notes: 60 runs, 391 assertions, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skips against four PostgreSQL databases

tests.command: RAILS_ENV=test ... bundle exec rails test test/test_support/foundation_helpers_test.rb test/controllers/application_shell_test.rb test/jobs/solid_stack_topology_test.rb test/adapters/contracts/provider_fake_contract_test.rb
tests.notes: representative unit, request, job and provider contract coverage; 21 runs, 153 assertions, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skips
3 runs, 11 assertions, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skips in headless Chrome; no artifact directory created on success
expected exit 1 produced ignored PNG, HTML and browser console files only on failure; probe source removed and artifacts moved to /tmp

tests.command: two identical foundation helper runs with --seed 4242 --verbose
tests.notes: both exited 0 and emitted the identical seven-test order

tests.command: RAILS_ENV=test SEARCHOPS_PROCESS_ROLE=worker_default mise exec ruby@3.4.10 -- bin/quality
tests.notes: 11 quality gates passed; 72 Ruby files clean, 19 ERB files clean, data/asset/architecture gates and security audits green
120 prompts and state consistent before completion

decisions: Default tests to one deterministic process with explicit PARALLEL_WORKERS opt-in; bind the hostile HTTP fixture permanently to 127.0.0.1; reject unscripted provider fake operations; retain PNG HTML and console artifacts for three CI days only after failures
risks: Helpers define reusable observable contracts but later tenant

usage and encryption models must still apply them to real PostgreSQL-backed behavior. Browser-console capture is best effort and records an explicit empty log when Chrome emitted no entries. The intentional artifact probe is the only expected failing invocation and was isolated under /tmp.
